summary: Hybrid export uses the finalized document canvas dimensions directly without preset aspect-ratio restrictions or export-time reflow.
invariants: Stored document width and height are authoritative for capture, coordinates and final PPTX size.
Aspect ratio is display metadata and must not select or replace stored dimensions.
Preserve finalized content and layout; reuse the existing Hybrid conversion path.
Generation preset selection remains separate from export size admission.
Only absent legacy canvas metadata may use the legacy canvas; malformed explicit metadata must fail.
forbidden: Silently resizing a document to a preset during export.
Claiming every Hybrid element is editable or equating file creation with visual acceptance.
evidence: User approved design-implementation-verification workflow in this conversation.
